page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.16xlarge belongs to the Local SSDs instance family, configured specifically for input/output intensive applications that require high-capacity, low-latency disk access alongside dedicated compute resources. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the server runs an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. It delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of memory, establishing a consistent memory density of 4.0 GB per core.

A key component of the hardware configuration is its bundled 3839 GB local solid-state drive (SSD), which provides direct-attached storage to avoid network storage overhead. The instance also features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps managed on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile does not include graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, bundling high-capacity local SSD storage with 64 dedicated cores allows organizations to run demanding storage workloads without configuring separate network-attached disk arrays. While local storage necessitates external redundancy strategies for high availability, it yields predictable single-node disk throughput and low latency per resource unit.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.16xlarge is architected for large-scale relational databases, distributed NoSQL database clusters, high-throughput log aggregation engines, search indexing, and real-time analytical data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.16xlarge is a storage-optimized instance within the Local SSDs family, driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 64 dedicated vCPUs clocked at 2.7 GHz alongside 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Designed for I/O-intensive workloads, the server includes a bundled 3839 GB local solid-state drive, removing the latency latency layer associated with network-attached block storage. Baseline network capacity is rated at 32 Gbps on the KVM hypervisor platform, with zero GPUs provisioned. By integrating massive local storage with dense dedicated computing and 32 Gbps network throughput, this server delivers a cost-efficient hardware setup for standalone and distributed data layers, including high-transaction relational databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, Elasticsearch clusters, and big data streaming engines.
